_doc: Gold annotations, DRAFT by Claude from reading each full thread; the team must review (set reviewed_by). Visible input = title+body at created_at. Everything below is hidden from the assistant. relevant_sources: source_ids (issue:N = any chunk of that issue available before as_of; doc pages may be given as 'page:/path' = any section). outcome: usage_guidance | known_issue | info_request | escalate. Several acceptable_next_steps are defensible; must_not lists clear failures.
